name: Sprig: Notes & Sketchbook
tagline: Type, sketch and keep notes in beautiful notebooks on your Android phone — everything stays on your device, no account needed.
storage_summary: Your notebooks, pages, drawings, photos and settings are stored only on your device. Sprig has no account and no server of its own. Pseudonymous usage events go to Google Analytics for Firebase so we can fix problems and improve the app: they are tied only to a random app-instance identifier, never to your name or an account, because Sprig has no sign-in. Your notes, drawings and photos are never sent.

google_play_billing.name: Google Play (in-app purchases)
google_play_billing.purpose: Processes the Sprig Premium subscription and tells the app whether it is active.
google_play_billing.data: your purchase record, handled by Google (we never see your payment details, Google Account or name)

firebase.name: Google Analytics for Firebase
firebase.purpose: Measures how the app is used (for example whether onboarding was finished or the Premium screen was opened) and collects basic diagnostics so we can fix problems and improve the app. This data is not linked to your identity — Sprig has no account, so it is tied only to a random app-instance identifier. Never used for advertising or cross-app tracking; Sprig does not collect your Android advertising ID. Sprig does not use a separate crash-reporting service.
firebase.data: a small set of usage events (never the content of your notes, drawings or photos), a random app-instance identifier, purchase events (product and result), basic diagnostic information such as app version, device model and OS version, locale, and an approximate region derived from your IP address (never your precise location)

data_sent.what: Usage events and purchase events (never the content of your notes, drawings or photos), a random app-instance identifier, basic diagnostic information (app version, device model, OS version), locale, and an approximate region derived from your IP address — not linked to your identity
data_sent.why: Understand how the app is used, find problems and improve the app

data_sent.what: Your purchase, only if you subscribe to Sprig Premium
data_sent.why: Process the subscription and confirm that it is active

stored_on_device: Your notebooks, pages, typed text, drawings, checklists, tags and the photos you add to a page.
Reminders you set on a note, and your settings such as sort order and appearance.
Deleted notebooks and pages stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days, then are removed.
If Android backup is turned on for your Google Account, Android may include the app's data in your device backup. That backup is made and stored by Google under your account; we cannot see it.
not_collected: Your name, email address or any account, because Sprig has no sign-in.
Your notes, drawings and photos — they never leave your device.
Your Android advertising ID; Sprig does not track you across other companies' apps or websites.
Your precise location. Google Analytics for Firebase sees only an approximate region derived from your IP address (see above); the app never asks for location access.
Payment details — Premium is bought through Google Play, and we never see your card, Google Account or name.

permissions.name: Notifications
permissions.why: to show a reminder you set on a note. Asked only when you first set a reminder; you can say no and still use every other feature.

permissions.name: Alarms & reminders
permissions.why: to deliver a note reminder at the time you chose, including after the phone restarts.

permissions.name: Photos
permissions.why: to add a picture to a page. Sprig uses the Android photo picker, so it only receives the photo you pick and never your whole library.

your_controls: **Delete a note or notebook** from its ••• menu; it moves to Recently Deleted (Settings → Recently Deleted), where you can delete it for good.
**Turn notifications off or on** in Android Settings → Apps → Sprig → Notifications.
**Delete all your data** by uninstalling the app or clearing its storage in Android Settings → Apps → Sprig → Storage — everything lives only on your device.

support_faq.a: On your device, inside the app. Sprig has no account and no cloud sync.

support_faq.q: My reminder arrived a few minutes late.
support_faq.a: Android may delay reminders to save battery. To get them on time, open Android **Settings → Apps → Sprig** and allow **Alarms & reminders**, and turn off battery optimization for Sprig.
Open Android **Settings → Apps → Sprig → Notifications** and turn notifications on.

support_faq.q: I deleted a note by mistake.
support_faq.a: Open **Settings → Recently Deleted** and tap **Restore**. Deleted notes are kept there for 30 days.

support_faq.q: How do I share or save a page?
support_faq.a: Open the page and tap the **share** icon (Export & Share) to save or share it as a PDF, an image or plain text. In the Notes list you can also use a note's **•••** menu → **Export**.

The free version includes one notebook plus Quick Notes. **Sprig Premium** unlocks unlimited notebooks, every premium cover, paper and font, and whole-notebook PDF export. It is an auto-renewing weekly or yearly subscription. The weekly plan starts with a 3-day free trial; cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends to avoid being charged.
